proposedOverrides.summary: Northern Rhodesia became independent from Britain as Zambia on 24 October 1964. The map’s Zambia records begin earlier, in 1920 and 1960, so those dates describe coverage of the territory rather than the founding of the independent republic.

sharedAssociations.basis: The imported labels andpositions identify the territory previously NorthernRhodesia and independent asZambiafrom1964. Bothmapintervals include colonialyears; sharedregionalhistorydoesnotbackdateindependence.
